Messages.Author: Michael Beer
Messages.Body:
Some new questions:

1. When you play Body of Sun, how much damage does any Retainer receive?

2. Will Nephandus special ability affect an opponent's weather control
or is it a "prevent damage" effect so it won't work with unpreventable
damage?

3. Blood of Acid affects the whole combat. What if played, both minions
enter a second round of combat, maneuver to long range and make long
range damage? BoA can only be played at close range, but is its effect a
close range only one?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
In article <342A8D...@leila.ping.de>, Mi...@leila.ping.de wrote:
> 1. When you play Body of Sun, how much damage does any Retainer receive?

Three if the round is at close range, one if at long range (card text).

> 2. Will Nephandus special ability affect an opponent's weather control
> or is it a "prevent damage" effect so it won't work with unpreventable
> damage?

Nephandus only reduces damage that "Opposing minions inflict".
Weather Control's damage is environmental - no inflicted by the
minion.

(But, his reduction ability can reduce "unpreventable" damage done
by the opposing minion - like from Blood Sweat)

> 3. Blood of Acid affects the whole combat. What if played, both minions
> enter a second round of combat, maneuver to long range and make long
> range damage? BoA can only be played at close range, but is its effect a
> close range only one?

Hmm. Looks like a sloppy template. Either BoA should only apply to the
current round's strike(s), or it should only apply when the range is
close. I'll check with the RT on that. (For now, go with the latter,
since that doesn't require me to overrule the RT). (*)

--
